title: Pattern-match rounds (BlockSize/DoubleBuf) are NO-OPs on scalar kernels
lesson: R02-R12 pattern-based optimization rounds (e.g., changing DEFAULT_BLOCK_M from 128→256, searching for InitBuffer calls) produce ZERO effect on the baseline BMM kernel. The baseline uses scalar GlobalTensor::GetValue/SetValue with no UB buffers — there's nothing for the pattern matcher to modify. A complete architectural rewrite (UB tiling + DMA) is prerequisite.
